What carried over

  • Unchanged: the rigs, every move and pose, the mocap player and its clips, Dan's body, the textures' code.
  • Card: the engine's own drawing, so the look is exact; flat, at one depth, lit by its own tones.
  • Puppet: the same joints wearing 3D parts listed as data; real depth, light and shadow, any camera; the look is an approximation.
  • New: perspective cameras, real shadows and lights, Rapier crates and the hero's controller.
